beginner.summary: For cloud engineers, administrators, auditors and new security analysts who are starting with cloud security posture management. Covers what CSPM finds and why misconfiguration causes breaches, shared responsibility, CIS Benchmarks, hands-on work in AWS Security Hub CSPM and AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Google Security Command Center, asset inventory, compliance dashboards, reading and triaging findings, storage, identity, network, logging, encryption and compute exposure, fixing findings by hand, exceptions and multi-cloud views.
prerequisites: Has created resources such as a virtual machine, a storage bucket and a firewall rule in AWS, Azure or Google Cloud
Understands IP addresses, ports, users, roles and permissions
Can run commands in a terminal with the AWS CLI, Azure CLI or gcloud
Training AWS account, Azure subscription and Google Cloud project supplied by the trainer, with security audit and contributor-level rights
outcomes: Explain what CSPM tools find, why misconfigurations lead to breaches and who owns each fix
Turn on and read AWS Security Hub CSPM, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Google Security Command Center
Triage storage, identity, network, logging, encryption and compute findings by severity, exposure and asset value
Fix findings safely by hand, record exceptions and report posture across three clouds
